app.name: Gita Counsel
app.tagline: Counsel drawn from the Bhagavad Gita, for moments when a decision will not move.

home.heading: When you cannot see the way forward
home.intro: Arjuna set down his bow between two armies and could not act. The second chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is Krishna's answer to that paralysis. This companion helps you sit with those verses when a choice of your own has stopped moving.
home.studyBlurb: All 18 chapters, verse by verse, in Sanskrit with translation.
home.chatBlurb: Describe what you are facing and see which verses speak to it.
home.reverenceNote: This application explains Krishna's teaching. It does not speak in his voice.

chat.heading: Ask for counsel
chat.intro: Describe the decision you are frozen in. The reply will draw only on verses from the chapters loaded here, and will name the verses it draws on.
chat.needsKey: To use counsel, add your own AI provider key in Settings.
chat.trialLast: This is your last free message.
chat.trialExhausted: Your free messages are used up. Adding your own key takes about two minutes and costs nothing.
chat.trialUnavailable: Add your own AI provider key in Settings to begin.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.notSaved: This reply could not be saved and will not appear in your history.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.keyIntro: Beyond any free trial messages, this application has no AI account of its own. You bring a key from a provider, and it is used only for your own conversations.
settings.trialSpent: You have used all {limit} free messages.
settings.trialIntro: New accounts get {limit} messages on our key. After that, bring your own — Gemini and Groq are free and need no payment card.

wizardGroq.step1: Open the Groq console and sign in (GitHub or Google works).
wizardGroq.step2: Go to API Keys and click “Create API Key”.
wizardGroq.step3: Copy the key it shows you and paste it above.
wizardGroq.note: Groq is free with no card, and its daily allowance is generous. It is the best choice for personal use.

wizardOpenai.step1: Open the OpenAI platform and sign in.
wizardOpenai.step2: Add credit under Billing, then open API keys and create one.
wizardOpenai.step3: Copy the key and paste it above.
wizardOpenai.note: OpenAI has no free API tier — a paid ChatGPT subscription does not include API access. Gemini or Groq is the easier starting point.

settings.keyInvalid: That key was not accepted by the provider. Please check it and try again.
settings.storedNote: Your key is encrypted before it is stored and is never shown back to you in full.
settings.signInRequired: Sign in to save a key.
settings.wizardIntro: This takes about two minutes and costs nothing.

wizardGemini.step1: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
wizardGemini.step2: Click “Get API key”, then “Create API key”.
wizardGemini.step3: Copy the key it shows you and paste it above.
wizardGemini.note: Google's free tier is enough for personal use. No card is required.

wizardAnthropic.step1: Open the Anthropic Console and create an account.
wizardAnthropic.step2: Add credit under Billing, then open API Keys and create one.
wizardAnthropic.step3: Copy the key and paste it above.
wizardAnthropic.note: Anthropic requires prepaid credit — there is no free tier. Gemini is the easier starting point.

settings.keyShapeHeading: This key was not sent to the provider.
settings.keyWrongProvider: That looks like a {detected} key, not a {provider} key. Pick {detected} above, or paste your {provider} key.
settings.keyWrongPrefix: A {provider} key starts with “{prefix}”. What you pasted does not.
settings.keyTooShort: That is {actual} characters; a {provider} key is at least {min}. The copy was probably cut short.
settings.keyInvalidCharacters: There are characters in there that a {provider} key does not contain — often an invisible one picked up by copying. Try re-copying it, or type it by hand.
settings.keyCleaned: Invisible characters were removed from what you pasted.
settings.keyUnusualFormat: The format was one this app did not recognise, but your provider accepted it — so it is fine.

auth.signInIntro: Signing in only identifies you, so your settings and saved key follow you between devices.
auth.signInNote: Any free trial messages are counted against your account. Once they are used, counsel runs on your own provider key.

search.heading: Find the verse that speaks to it
search.intro: Describe a situation in your own words. This searches the meaning of every verse, not just its wording, and costs nothing — no sign-in, no AI key.
